actions.label: Clear the path and type filters
actions.caption: esc clears the structure filters. Bring the whole outline back when you finish inspecting one kind of field.

actions.label: Visit the next matching path
actions.caption: n moves to the next path left by the string filter. Step through matching fields without opening every object.

actions.label: Visit the previous matching path
actions.caption: n moves forward once; N goes back through matching paths. Use it when you pass the field you need.

actions.label: Find a structure path
actions.caption: / opens the path filter; type name and enter to keep matching paths. Use the original structure when you want a compact outline of matching keys.

actions.label: Filter by value type
actions.caption: t changes the original structure filter from strings to numbers. Find numeric fields before inspecting their values.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
